title: The polite and assertive live-region wrappers are preseeded on every declared route before any notification fires
asA: screen-reader user of a shipped rcf-lite application
iWant: the polite and assertive live-region wrappers to be present in the DOM at page load on every route so that the first notification fires into a container the accessibility tree already tracks
soThat: no informational or assertive message is silently lost by a race between the wrapper insertion and the content insertion, per the WAI-ARIA 1.2 live-regions normative contract

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a page load on any declared route, both live-region wrappers are preseeded in the DOM before any notification fires: the polite wrapper carries `aria-live="polite"` and `data-live-region="polite"` and is empty (no descendant text nodes) at page load; the assertive wrapper carries `role="alert"` and `data-live-region="assertive"` and is empty at page load. A wrapper inserted lazily after the first event, or a wrapper that carries content at page load, fails this AC. The pack enumerates wrappers by `[data-live-region]` (per-element attribute), not by `aria-live` or `role` alone.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a page load on any declared route
acceptanceCriteria.then: both preseeded wrappers are present, carry their id attribute, and are empty

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the shell's live-region factory (TAC-2101 `renderLiveRegions`), a call at first render emits exactly two wrapper elements matching the AC-20101-1 shape and never re-creates them on subsequent renders (the wrappers are stable identity across the app lifetime). A factory that recreates the wrappers on a route change fails this AC at project-side review.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the factory is invoked at first render and again on a route change
acceptanceCriteria.then: the same two wrapper elements are returned; identity is stable
